clue.text: Accountant taken in by traveller's summary

indicators.note: something taken in by another is held within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a traveller is a commercial traveller, a sales rep
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A salesman's account of his trip, as reported by the bookkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief restatement of the main points is a synonym of a summary.

clue.text: Splendid adage for those working with grain?

definitions.note: a tool for woodworkers cutting along the grain of timber

parts.note: ripping is old British slang for splendid
a saw is an old saying

explanation.surface: A cheerful motto for farmers or bakers who handle grain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grain' suggests corn, but it is the grain of wood: this saw cuts along it.
explanation.definitionFit: This carpenter's tool is designed to cut timber lengthwise, along the fibres of the wood.

clue.text: Production of Haydn's oratorio

definitions.meaning: the act of making or bringing something into being
Haydn's famous oratorio of 1798 about the making of the world

explanation.definitionFit: Making something is bringing it into being, and Haydn's oratorio bears that title.

clue.text: Miserable wage eamed from inept act

indicators.note: the answer is presented as produced out of the following letters, which are reworked

explanation.surface: A poor performer is paid a pittance for a bad show.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of INEPT ACT are rearranged; 'from' signals that the answer is made out of them. 'eamed' is a print slip for 'earned'.
explanation.definitionFit: A very small, inadequate amount of pay is what a miserable wage amounts to.

clue.text: A pointless contest for the loser

definitions.text: A pointless contest for the loser

parts.words: A pointless contest for the loser
parts.note: in tennis, a game where the losing player scores no points at all

explanation.definitionFit: In tennis, nil is called love, so a game won without the opponent scoring takes that name.

clue.text: Imperfect material

definitions.meaning: weak or unconvincing, as a poor excuse is
...é, a fabric woven with metallic threads

explanation.definitionFit: A feeble excuse is described as unconvincing, and lamé is a shiny metallic fabric.

clue.text: Makes it correct for me to be in tails

indicators.note: one piece is to be placed inside another

parts.note: tails are ends
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man decides he will look proper only in a tailcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text, removing its errors, is a synonym phrase for making it correct.

clue.text: Plate put up for horse, for example

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting a word up reads it from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a lamina is a thin plate or layer

explanation.surface: A trophy plate is offered as a prize for a horse race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plate' suggests a racing trophy, but it is LAMINA, a thin layer.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse is one example of a beast, a living creature of the kingdom of fauna.

clue.text: If there's a man around, he's from the U.S.

indicators.note: the letters of 'a man' sit around this name in the longer word, so taking them away leaves it

parts.note: someone from the United States is an American
taken as written, the letters A, M, A, N

explanation.surface: Any man who comes round here must be a Yank.
explanation.walkthrough: Put A M at the front and AN at the end of this name and you get AMERICAN; 'he' is the definition, a boy's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male first name stands for any he, a male person.

clue.text: Plucky guitarist's agent

parts.note: the small tool a guitarist uses to pluck the strings

explanation.definitionFit: A guitar pick is the small device with which a player plucks the strings.

clue.text: In distribution of income company is thrifty

indicators.note: distributing the letters spreads them out into a new order

explanation.surface: A firm sharing its income carefully is behaving prudently.
explanation.walkthrough: INCOME plus CO are rearranged together, signalled by 'In distribution of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Careful with money and avoiding waste is the sense of frugal, as in an economic use of resources.

clue.text: Those who crib in exams upset teachers

indicators.note: upset letters are knocked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Teachers are upset to find pupils copying in exams.
explanation.definitionFit: To crib is to copy dishonestly, so cribbers are those who cheat.

clue.text: Plainly distressed, but retains composure

indicators.note: read as com-posure, a fresh composing or arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone clearly upset nevertheless keeps calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composure' looks like calm; read cryptically it signals putting RETAINS together anew.
explanation.definitionFit: Weeping openly is a visible sign of being upset.

clue.text: Wise step in the present era

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: sage means wise
a pace is a step

explanation.surface: A clever move suits modern times.
explanation.definitionFit: Our own times are often called after space travel, the epoch of rockets and satellites.

clue.text: Two words for "iron used by group of journalists

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them; an iron is a type of golf club
to iron clothes is to press them; an iron is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A quiz asks for synonyms of a household iron.
explanation.definitionFit: A club whose members are journalists, meeting as a body of reporters.

clue.text: Where publicans may be locked up

definitions.meaning: pub landlords stand at the back of their counters

explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner is held in a cell, and a landlord stands at the counter serving drinks.

clue.text: Order to be dispatched

parts.note: a court's command that someone be put to death, not a parcel being sent

explanation.definitionFit: A judge's capital verdict commands that the convicted be executed.

clue.text: They may be used for cutting a suit

definitions.text: They may be used for cutting
definitions.meaning: hard gems set in tools that cut glass and stone
one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards

explanation.definitionFit: These hard gemstones are used in cutting tools and also name a suit of playing cards.

clue.text: Fit to follow Charlton in football

definitions.meaning: physically strong and in good condition
Charlton ... is a London football club

explanation.definitionFit: Being sporty and in good shape is fit, and the word completes the London club's name.

clue.text: Though maybe of a low rank I seem in exultant mood

parts.note: a walk-on is an actor in a minor non-speaking part, a lowly role
an air is the impression one gives, how one seems

explanation.surface: Even a humble person may feel elated.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly the answer is a verb phrase; the definition describes the state it expresses.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel elated is idiomatically to tread as if floating, so the phrase means being very happy.

clue.text: Such a cleaning implement is barely used

definitions.text: Such a cleaning implement is barely used

parts.words: Such a cleaning implement is barely used
parts.note: a bath sponge, used on the naked body

explanation.definitionFit: This dried gourd is a scrubber used in the bath on bare skin.

clue.text: Key batsman?

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a batsman who begins the innings

explanation.definitionFit: A key unlocks things, and a cricketer who bats first starts the innings.

clue.text: Tried to see a politician in vehicle

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a sled is a vehicle on runners
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to visit an MP who is riding a sledge.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasted or tested something is a synonym for having tried it.

clue.text: He made himself a butt of cynicism

definitions.text: He made himself a butt of cynicism

parts.words: He made himself a butt of cynicism
parts.note: the founding Cynic philosopher said to have lived in a large tub, a butt

explanation.definitionFit: The Greek Cynic philosopher famously lived in a tub or barrel.

clue.text: American lawyer given thanks for information

parts.note: a DA is a District Attorney in the USA
ta is British informal for thanks

explanation.surface: A US attorney is thanked for the facts.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts and figures collected for use are a synonym of information.

clue.text: Company way out with tax

indicators.note: the way piece is put on the outside of the company

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A firm finds a way to escape paying tax.
explanation.walkthrough: A scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free.
explanation.definitionFit: An old municipal levy bore this name, which survives in the phrase scot-free.

clue.text: It may be served in porcelain at meal-time

parts.note: china is fine porcelain
tea is an afternoon or evening meal

explanation.surface: A drink is poured into fine cups at the evening meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A drink made from Chinese leaves is something served to guests.

clue.text: Supporter likely to maintain contact

definitions.meaning: a follower or partisan of a cause
sticky, inclined to cling to a surface

explanation.definitionFit: A follower sticks to a cause, and a sticky thing tends to cling.

clue.text: Dismisses part of the wind section, we hear

indicators.note: this signals that the word is spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: saxophones, saxes, are part of an orchestra's wind section

explanation.surface: An orchestra lets go some of its wind players.
explanation.definitionFit: To fire workers is to give them their cards, i.e. dismisses them.
